import datetime


def next_billing_date(start: datetime.date, months_ahead: int) -> datetime.date:
    """Return the billing date `months_ahead` months after `start`,
    keeping the same day-of-month (clamped to the last day of the
    target month when necessary)."""
    # Convert to an absolute month index (0-based) and add the offset
    total_months = start.year * 12 + (start.month - 1) + months_ahead
    target_year = total_months // 12
    target_month = total_months % 12 + 1

    # Find the last day of the target month by subtracting one day
    # from the first day of the following month.
    if target_month == 12:
        first_of_next = datetime.date(target_year + 1, 1, 1)
    else:
        first_of_next = datetime.date(target_year, target_month + 1, 1)

    last_day = (first_of_next - datetime.timedelta(days=1)).day

    # Clamp the day to the last valid day of the target month
    target_day = min(start.day, last_day)

    return datetime.date(target_year, target_month, target_day)
